per_question.answer: To avoid academic warning, an undergraduate needs to maintain a minimum CGPA of 2.00 [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Academic Assessment > Academic Warning/Probation].

If a student's CGPA stays below 2.00 for three consecutive semesters, their admission will be automatically closed [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Academic Assessment > Academic Warning/Probation].
A student can repeat a maximum of 2 courses in a summer semester, [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 6. Rules for Summer Semester].

Students earning an SGPA of 4.00 with at least 30 credit hours are placed on the Rector's List of Honors [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 7. Awards and the Honor System > Rector’s List of Honors].

If a teacher refers a cheating case to the Department Disciplinary Committee, the maximum punishment of 'F' grade can be awarded in that course [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 8. Academic Honesty > Penalties for Academic Dishonesty].

A student is not allowed to submit an assignment written by a generative AI tool as their own work [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Unacceptable Uses of Generative AI Tools]. This is because using Generative AI software to create entire assessments that they then disguise as their own original work is considered academic misconduct. According to the fee refund policy, if a student leaves within the first 15 days of classes, 80% of the tuition fee is refunded [fee-structure-page.html / Fee Refund Policy].

A faculty member must have been a full-time faculty member for more than 1 year to be eligible to start a technical start-up [faculty-entrepreneurship-and-technical-start-ups-policy.pdf / 1. Purpose > Eligibility criteria for a technical start-up].
According to the 2023-24 annual report, the Islamabad campus had a total of 236 faculty members [annual-report-2023-24.pdf / CFD ISB KHI LHR PWR > Faculty Summary].

The deadline to withdraw from a course is the last day of the makeup week of every semester, as stated in section 4.25 of the Academic Rules Handbook, June 2026, page 22 [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 4. Registration > Withdrawal from a Course].
A regular semester is spread over 16 weeks of teaching, [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 1. Introduction > Academic Year].
Under the older 2023 academic rules, the deadline to withdraw from a course is the last day of classes [undergraduate-academic-rules-aug-2023.pdf / 4. Registration > Withdrawal from a Course].

Students are required to maintain 100% attendance in lectures, labs, tutorials, seminars and discussions as prescribed by the course instructor [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 1. Introduction > Attendance Requirements]. The paper rechecking fee per course is Rs. 500, as stated in the Miscellaneous Fees section of the fee-structure-page.html, [fee-structure-page.html / Miscellaneous Fees].
A B- grade is worth 2.67 grade points [prospectus-2026-academic-rules-and-regulations.pdf / 6. Letter Grades and Grade Points].
